refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.html:
Refunds

A refund is the negative of the amount paid, computed in one place: the refund function in alpha-lib. Every caller in this estate reaches it, either directly or through RefundHandler.

Mechanisms

  • refund(amount) in alpha-lib's src/refund.ts returns -amount. It holds no

state and performs no checks.

  • RefundHandler.handle(amount) in the same file passes the amount straight to

refund.

  • beta-app's PaymentService.pay in src/pay.ts imports refund from the

@example/alpha-lib package, so a payment in beta-app is computed by the library rather than by its own code.

  • The refund schema in alpha-lib, schemas/refund.schema.json, describes a

refund request: a requestedOn date and a total that refers to the money definition.

Evidence

DEMO-1 introduced the handler in alpha-lib and the call from beta-app. DEMO-2 added the schema.

What this is NOT

This is not a payment ledger. Nothing in the estate stores a refund, approves one or sends money: those questions need another source.
